# Synthetic Handoff Reader

This short document was written for EasySink development. It contains no private book text, notes, model output, or licensed excerpt.

## First passage

Mira opened the field notebook after sunrise. A small diagram showed how a stream divided around two stones and joined again beyond the bridge. She marked one sentence, added a note, and checked that the same word on the next page stayed independent.

## Cross-page passage

The instrument did not promise certainty. It recorded a sequence of observations, preserved their order, and allowed a later reader to return to the exact source. When the window changed size, the page number changed, but the source location did not.

## Final passage

After reviewing the translation, Mira selected its second sentence. The reader returned to the matching source, kept the earlier paragraph still, and saved the newest intent instead of a delayed request.
